files.name: Experiment1-Results.xlsx
files.notable_manual_adjustment: Detection-rate!E9 formula is =1338-78 rather than a direct frame-level human-label derivation.

files.name: Experiment_1-CSV_HyDaT.zip
files.member_pattern: bee_test_HyDaT_1.csv ... bee_test_HyDaT_7.csv plus run timestamp txt files
files.evidence: For videos 1-6 the count of rows with algorithm occlusion==0 exactly equals the HyDaT detected-frame count in Experiment1-Results.xlsx. The same field behaves differently from the YOLO output and therefore cannot be a shared human label.

files.name: Experiment_1-CSV_YOLO.zip
files.member_pattern: bee_test_ML_1.csv ... bee_test_ML_7.csv plus run timestamp txt files
files.evidence: For all seven videos the count of rows with algorithm occlusion==0 exactly equals the stand-alone YOLO detected-frame count in Experiment1-Results.xlsx.

experiment_2_comparator.name: Experiment_2 - Observations_Record.xlsx
experiment_2_comparator.structure: Per-honeybee contingency entries explicitly headed Human Observation with Occluded / Exited FoV / Other, cross-tabulated against HyDaT Estimate.
experiment_2_comparator.provenance_implication: The deposit explicitly labels human-observation records when they are supplied. No analogous Experiment 1 observation-record file is present in the complete Experiment_Data.zip member index.

decision.primary_v10_truth_strategy: controlled known perturbations on byte-frozen real video pixels; do not claim biological-event detection accuracy without a new independent human annotation source
